title: Everyone on your slide
subtitle: A switch that makes every other browser follow the presenter's
bullets: The presenter logs in once: press P, and type the password in the window that opens
Every browser that is not the presenter's then shows the presenter's slide
Their arrow keys stop working: the audience cannot run ahead
task: Say this. Then press P in one live window, log in, and move. The other window follows. This task cannot tick itself.
prompt: In .env, set PRESENTER_CONTROLLED to true, then restart the live server.
